Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-s-upcoming-election-marred-by-rising-ai-disinformation/a-79946897?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nigeria has just over two months to go until its general election, with incumbent bola tinubu running on a ticket focused on combating raging insecurity and resolving the nation's economic crisis. He faces off against former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and senior opposition figure Peter Obi.

The country's electoral body, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), recently released its preliminary voter's register, which reportedly is riddled with images believed to have been generated using artificial intelligence (AI).

Among the telltale signs of AI usage were exaggerated facial features in images and inconsistencies on the electoral registers, such as duplicates of names and even identities of people who since the previous election had died.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the development raises concerns about the body's overall preparedness ahead of the country's upcoming 2027 general election. Instead of making the upcoming vote more transparent by allowing access to its procedures, INEC has come under fire amid broader controversies about the expanding influence of AI in elections across the continent.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

Joash Amupitan, the chairman of the electoral commission, said the body is now investigating the development, focusing on discrepancies potentially created by AI use.

To this end, he announced the establishment of a dedicated unit to monitor AI-related threats, detect deepfakes and strengthen the integrity of the electoral process, warning that the credibility of the upcoming election could otherwise be under attack.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, even prior to the proliferation of ai across africa and the globe, this would not be the first time that nigeria has found itself in the unfortunate position of having to deal with the circulation of fabricated images, doctored audio and fake videos online. In the run-up to the 2023 election, deepfakes falsely linking candidates to terror-related activities filled social media platforms.

These are often designed to promote certain candidates or to discredit opponents in a bid to influence public perception, which now with the use of AI could create disinformation campaigns of new proportions.

Diungkapkan bahwa lois ugbede, the assistant editor at the factchecking platform dubawa, told dw that "based on our monitoring so far, ai-driven disinformation is serious and is becoming commonplace. ".

"This could influence political discourse and voter behavior ahead of 2027 because we are already seeing parties using inflated crowds to show that they have a large followership or support," she added.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

At the same time, rather than influencing the vote in favor of any particular candidate, "the deeper danger is that people may begin to doubt authentic information simply because they know convincing AI-generated fakes are possible," said Akintunde Babatunde, executive director of the Abuja-based Centre for Journalism, Innovation and Development.

"We often focus on the risk of people believing an AI-generated falsehood, but there is another problem where genuine evidence can be dismissed as AI-generated," he noted, citing instances of a lawmaker who recently made inflammatory remarks during a campaign rally — but then claimed the clips were manipulated.

Berdasarkan laporan, chibuike mgbeahuruike, an election consultant at the centre for democracy and development, told dw that apart from the spread of synthetic content online, ai intrusion into the electoral commission's portal could also "undermine its institutional credibility, especially with the low level of confidence that we are already witnessing. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, he added, however, that ai itself is not inherently a threat to electoral integrity. The real threat lies in "the absence of effective accountability for its deployment," as innovations in tech increasingly appear to infiltrate governments and their democratic processes.

"Voters must have confidence … that the technology is also transparent, accountable and independently scrutinized, and ultimately subject to human and institutional oversight," said Mgbeahuruike.

Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace, the director-general of state-owned broadcaster Voice of Nigeria, agrees, urging journalists at a recent conference also to not fall into the trap of believing reports, which later could turn out to be false due to AI manipulation.

He stressed the importance of protection measures and due diligence in news media, with the growing inability of public institutions like INEC to provide impartial information due to the use and influence of AI and other election-related tech.

Beyond AI, Nigeria's electoral processes have undergone various technological shifts over the years in hopes of improving transparency while increasing efficiency.

Electoral authorities first deployed electronic assistance in 2011, when Direct Data Capture Machines were introduced; the devices collect voters' biometrics by scanning fingerprints or capturing facial recognition data with webcams to stop voters from submitting multiple ballots.

Diungkapkan bahwa ten years later, a system called the bimodal voter accreditation system (bvas) was introduced as the new standard, designed to combine fingerprints with facial recognition. However, during the 2023 general election, this voting process was marred by system failures, as poor cell signals delayed these voter accreditation procedures.

However, with INEC tallying more than 103 million Nigerians registered to participate in the coming poll, disinformation, fake news and technological challenges amount to only a few of several concerns pertaining to Nigeria's democracy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, voter apathy has become a particular concern, especially among the country's youth. The 2023 election recorded the lowest voter turnout since the country's return to democratic rule in 1999, with merely 27% of registered voters going to the polls.

Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins’ victory means Democrats will now hold 30 US governorships after midterm blowout.

Democrats have captured Alaska’s governor’s seat for the first time in nearly three decades, marking another major victory for their party in a midterm election period that has dramatically shifted political power across the US.

Former Alaska state legislator Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins defeated three Republican opponents, including a candidate backed by Donald Trump, becoming the first Democrat elected governor of Alaska since 1998.

Diungkapkan bahwa his victory – called by the associated press on friday, 10 days after the polls closed – adds to a growing list of democratic gains nationwide, bringing the party’s total to 30 us governorships. Democrats have also taken control of governor’s offices in several other longtime Republican strongholds, including Iowa, Georgia, Ohio and Texas.

Kreiss-Tomkins, widely known as JKT, secured the win having mounted a political comeback three years after departing the Alaska house of representatives.

The 37-year-old traveled extensively throughout the state during his campaign, building support around economic concerns and a promise to change the direction of Alaska’s government.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, his platform centered on tackling affordability, ensuring full funding for public education, and requiring all oil and gas producers to pay corporate income taxes. He also pushed for a temporary halt to new datacenter developments until state lawmakers establish regulations governing their construction.

Throughout the campaign, Kreiss-Tomkins sharply criticized the leadership of outgoing the Republican governor, Mike Dunleavy, arguing that Alaska had become “broken” during his eight years in office.

Berdasarkan laporan, “alaskans are hungry for change,” kreiss-tomkins said. “We’ve been running the same campaign since we launched in February, and I don’t take anyone’s vote for granted. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, among his criticisms was the deterioration of the state’s ferry system, which kreiss-tomkins said had been left in disarray as service to numerous communities was drastically reduced. Sebagaimana diketahui, despite his criticism of the outgoing administration, kreiss-tomkins presented himself as a leader willing to work across political divisions. He pledged to assemble a cabinet that includes Democrats, Republicans and independents.

Unlike most states, Alaska allows voters to rank candidates by preference through ranked-choice voting – a system that also permits multiple candidates from the same political party to run against one another.

But Kreiss-Tomkins avoided the need for additional rounds of vote counting after winning more than 50% of first-choice votes, securing an outright victory.

The Alaska result comes just days after Democrats scored another major gubernatorial win in staunchly conservative Kansas, where the Democratic state senator Cindy Holscher narrowly defeated the Republican state senate president, Ty Masterson.

Berdasarkan laporan, masterson, who received trump’s endorsement, faced a campaign in which holscher repeatedly highlighted his ties to the republican president. At the same time, Holscher maintained that she would remain willing to cooperate with the Trump administration on issues where common ground could be found.

The back-to-back victories in Alaska and Kansas underscore the scale of Democratic gains in what has become a nationwide electoral shift.

The party’s long-anticipated “blue wave” has now materialized, with Democrats flipping eight seats in the US Senate, gaining more than two dozen seats in the House and significantly expanding their control of governors’ offices after the 3 November midterms.

Such gains have handed Democrats a strong majority in Congress for the latter half of Trump’s second presidency, delivering a major shift in the balance of power in Washington and state governments across the US.

Berdasarkan laporan, meanwhile, with few ballots left to count for alaska’s midterm us senate election, democrat mary peltola on saturday was leading republican incumbent dan s sullivan, alaska public media reported. That had prompted MS Now to characterize that Senate race as “leans Democratic”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beside alaska and kansas, the democratic party won gubernatorial elections over republicans in georgia, iowa, nevada, ohio and texas, putting them in control of a majority of governorships for the first time since 2010. Gina Hinojosa is the first Democrat to be elected governor of Texas in 35 years – and also the state’s first Hispanic governor.

A major factor in the GOP’s midterm defeat is the unpopularity of Trump, whom most Republican lawmakers clung to even as polls indicated voters did not support his immigration crackdown, tariffs, the war with Iran or his signature domestic policy bill.

Diungkapkan bahwa kiir dissolved south sudan's transitional government in september ahead of elections, and has since ruled by decree in a caretaker administration. He fired Vice President Machar, who had earlier been charged with treason and is under house arrest.

Berdasarkan laporan, investigators believe the 34-year-old woman had failed to put the chevrolet 1500 in park and likely put her foot on the gas pedal while sleeping at the stryker sports complex in wichita on 17 october. Berdasarkan laporan, bennett said people who immediately pulled the driver from the truck found her sleepy, “sobbing, at turns described as frantic, hysterical, saying, ‘i’m sorry, i’m sorry. What have I done?’”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as fears of regional escalation grew after us strikes on iran, us president donald trump claimed the us-israel war with iran was "effectively over" on november 9 at a white house briefing. "We're just keeping it the status quo. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, periods of heightened public interest, such as the conflict involving iran, create fertile ground for so-called content farms. Following Trump's statement, posts on the Iran war surged online again. And a growing network of accounts claiming links to Iran's military has accumulated millions of views.

Diungkapkan bahwa dw fact check examined a number of these accounts and found recurring signs of content farm behavior. Experts who reviewed the accounts DW provided describe them as part of a broader ecosystem of pro-Iran content aggregators that connect across multiple social media platforms.

Sebagaimana diketahui, content farms are websites or social media accounts, or a network of either, producing large amounts of cheap content in a short time span. They may be driven by economic incentives, but they can also serve as vehicles for political influence campaigns.

Berdasarkan laporan, the internet watchdog newsguard has found 165 false claims about the iran warthat collectively have been watched hundreds of millions of times. Only a few of them originated from Iranian state media.

NewsGuard identified the majority as pushing a pro-Iran agenda, shifting toward AI-generated images, and increasingly claiming that accurate stories from authentic media are AI-generated and false.

Sebagaimana diketahui, an analysis by the london-based institute for strategic dialogue (isd) identified pro-iran networks of x accounts which revealed signs of coordination, cross-promotion and engagement tactics while spreading misleading and ai-generated war content. It found no links to state-affiliated actors.

Sebagaimana diketahui, several accounts identified by dw fact check use the iranian flag as their profile picture and a variation of "iran military" in their username. While ownership cannot always be verified, they share recurring characteristics commonly associated with content farms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, content farms use repetitive and formulaic posting formats, as they are cheaper and easier to produce. Their posts frequently start with the word "BREAKING" and imitate the appearance of news updates on the conflict.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one account, called "iran military media," is linked to a facebook account that iranian state media have verified as authentic. It has built a substantial audience across multiple social media platforms, with over 290,000 followers on X, 597,000 on Facebook and 17,200 followers on Instagram.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it posts a handful of times a day, often sharing ai-generated or ai-enhanced videos and frequently adopting the "breaking" format. Since late 2025, it has published more than 1,600 posts on X, generating over 150 million views and 3. 6 million likes.

"The accounts discussed are a central part of this ecosystem as they distribute the pro-Iranian content, state and non-state allied media at relatively low cost and generate millions of views," said Moustafa Ayad, an expert in online influence operations at the ISD.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ayad examined 10 similar "iran military"-themed accounts during the same period, and their combined reach is even greater. Together, they accounted for 12,588 posts, 353 million views and 6. 6 million likes.

Diungkapkan bahwa this network is replicated on facebook in numerous languages. According to Ayad, this strategy is part of what the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei outlined as "soft war. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa ayad said the accounts' reach is amplified when they are paired with other accounts. Only a small share of "Iran Military Media's" 150 million views came from reposted content.

Diungkapkan bahwa a second account, "iranian force," has amassed more than 248,000 followers. It typically posts around 10 times a day, though on some days the volume exceeds 30 posts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, like "iran military media," it frequently relies on "breaking" alerts and ai-generated content. It also includes genuine footage, often framed through a pro-Iran lens.

Sebagaimana diketahui, x lists the account as being based in pakistan and its profile history shows six username changes. In a break from the Iran-related content, one post suddenly defends a Pakistani TikToker and includes an appeal in Urdu to the government in Pakistan.

Diungkapkan bahwa charlene lin, an analyst for the internet watchdog newsguard, told dw it had flagged this account for multiple false narratives. According to Lin, it is also linked to another account that spreads the same false narratives in coordination.

Diungkapkan bahwa a third account, called the "iran army," posts a handful of times a day, including ai-generated videos. Its posts regularly reach tens and at times hundreds of thousands of views.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, like "iranian force," it distributes videos from official briefings by the iranian armed forces while also using the "breaking" format to drive engagement. One post claiming "the war has officially started" received over 41 million views.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

Berdasarkan laporan, while these accounts differ in reach and post slightly different content, they share many characteristics. The accounts repeatedly share cheaply produced images, at times coordinated between accounts, and make sensational and unverified claims portraying Iran as militarily powerful or politically influential.

Berdasarkan laporan, several accounts in this wider ecosystem have faced restrictions. Since March, a number of prominent "Iran Military"-themed accounts have been suspended on X, including "Iran Military Monitor," which had close to 2 million followers before its removal.

Earlier this year, Iranian state media issued a statement distancing itself from a range of "Iran Military" accounts circulating on social media, stating that only one account was authentic.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yet for social media users, distinguishing that account from the others may not be straightforward. The verified account uses the same "Iran Military" branding and a similar profile picture, while also sharing AI-generated content and frequent "BREAKING" updates.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite differences in authenticity and affiliation, many of these accounts consistently adopt a pro-iran framing. They portray Iran as militarily capable, able to retaliate against adversaries and enjoying international support, while rarely highlighting information that contradicts that image.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dw fact check found repeated postings of the same content close in time across the accounts and different platforms. The "Iranian Force" and "Iran Military Media" accounts have, for example, posted the same image (here and here), with the same caption on the same day, as have accounts in the wider "Iran Military Media" network.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the pro-iranian ecosystem online is large, multi-layered and cuts across almost all of the various popular social media platforms and messaging services," said the isd's ayad. "[It's] a key component to the Iranian government's ability to withstand challenges to its rule both from within and outside, while generating sympathy and connections with other online communities. ".

#611. Asia’s Eurovision Contest Is Missing China, India, Pakistan, Indonesia and Japan

📅 14 Nov 2026

Asia’s Eurovision Contest Is Missing China, India, Pakistan, Indonesia and Japan

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/world/asia/eurovision-asia-china-japan.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, china, india, pakistan, indonesia and japan aren’t joining the singing contest. That leave some of the region’s best-known musical cultures out of the mix.

For a competition meant to introduce the diversity of Asian pop music to the world, the lineup for the first Eurovision Song Contest Asia has several notable absences.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for starters, the continent’s four most populous nations — china, india, pakistan and indonesia — won’t be there. Even Japan, a country globally considered a cultural powerhouse, is absent.

Diungkapkan bahwa that leaves some of the region’s best-known musical cultures out of the mix. India has Bollywood hits. China has produced both Mandopop and Cantopop, the genre associated with Hong Kong pop stars. JPop was once huge across Asia.

As a result, the only large pop powerhouse in this contest is South Korea.

Sebagaimana diketahui, china’s absence is relatively simple to explain. Performers are entered by local broadcasters, and Eurovision has long had a messy relationship with China’s, which are heavily regulated and try to reflect the government’s social and political values. Mango TV once had a deal to broadcast the high-camp Eurovision to Chinese viewers, but Eurovision abruptly canceled it in 2018 after Mango TV censored acts whose performances featured gay themes. It also blurred rainbow flags in the performance arena.

Frank-Dieter Freiling, a former Eurovision official, said in an interview that such censorship was against Eurovision’s values and that the show’s organizers had historically barred broadcasters from airing the competition with delays.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s less clear why broadcasters from india, pakistan, japan and indonesia are not participating. Assaf Blecher, Eurovision Asia’s executive producer, said that conversations with Chinese, Japanese and Indian broadcasters had not concluded in time. But he insisted that they “are knocking on our door. ”.

Not participating saves those countries the potential embarrassment of being the regional power that comes in last.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just look to europe, where britain and germany often perform badly at eurovision. In this year’s show, Britain’s Look Mum No Computer placed last, scoring only one point, while Germany finished third from last. Whenever that happens, political commentators give interviews suggesting that the results reflect those countries’ poor standing across Europe.

Diungkapkan bahwa alex marshall is a times reporter covering european culture. He is based in London.

Francesca Regalado is a Times reporter covering breaking news.

When everyone is just shouting into their own bubbles or communities, we need journalists who connect these bubbles with one another," he said.

On the contrary, we must take a clear stand against racism, antisemitism, Islamophobia, discrimination, sexism, and hate speech — no matter which side they come from. #613. Turkey uses espionage accusations to pressure government critics

📅 14 Nov 2026

Turkey uses espionage accusations to pressure government critics

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-uses-espionage-accusations-to-pressure-government-critics/a-79943768?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf

Berdasarkan laporan, the arrest of a german foundation's employee in istanbul this week has put the focus back on pressure tactics used by the erdogan administration. The arrest is far from the first of its kind.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when police officers appeared at her home in istanbul last wednesday evening, yonca verdioglu sik was surprised — even more so when they took her in for questioning. Her lawyer says she was accused of political and military espionage.

Berdasarkan laporan, but, according to transcripts of the interrogation that were published later, verdioglu sik was never asked any questions about espionage. Instead the public prosecutor's office appeared to be more interested in the activities of her German employer, the Heinrich Böll Foundation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for 18 years, verdioglu sik, who was born and raised in germany, has been the foundation's project coordinator. In her role, she organizes projects that focus on democracy and the rights of women, minorities and LGBTQ+ people.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during the interrogation, transfers of money from the foundation into her bank account were discussed. Verdioglu Sik found out that she was now also subject to a travel ban.

Diungkapkan bahwa verdioglu sik was eventually released, but her arrest caused outrage among critics of the turkish government. She is married to investigative journalist and member of parliament, Ahmet Sik. He belongs to the left-wing Workers' Party of Turkey, or TIP, and is known as one of the harshest critics of the current government.

Sik has recently been looking into a stock market scandal, which allegedly benefited members of the ruling Justice and Development Party, or AKP, headed by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, and associates.

Sebagaimana diketahui, opposition critics drew a clear conclusion: as a member of parliament, sik has parliamentary immunity. So instead, the justice system is putting pressure on him through his wife.

"If you take away a state's law, what is left is no longer called a state, but a gang," Sik responded to the arrest in writing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, verdioglu sik's arrest is not the first such case in turkey. Ever since the attempted coup against the Erdogan government in 2016, accusations of espionage have been leveled at a wide variety of groups in Turkey: journalists, opposition figures and human rights activists as well as employees of foreign embassies and staff of foreign institutions like nongovernmental organizations and foundations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, such accusations have often been followed by acquittals or convictions for other offenses, albeit sometimes years later. But what the many instances have in common is what's known as a "chilling effect. " Any investigation can mean lengthy pre-trial detention, reputational and professional damage and even social isolation.

In the past, such cases have even triggered diplomatic spats.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2015, for example, can dundar and erdem gul, both senior journalists at the opposition daily cumhuriyet, were accused of espionage after reporting that turkey had tried to ship arms to rebels fighting the syrian government. Dundar now lives in exile in Berlin.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in 2017, erdogan said that reporter deniz yücel, then working for german newspaper die welt, was a "german agent. " That led to a serious diplomatic crisis between Berlin and Ankara.

Diungkapkan bahwa espionage charges have also been laid against local employees of the us diplomatic corps and against a lawyer working for the german embassy. US pastor Andrew Brunson and his wife were also arrested because of alleged links to Kurdish anti-government groups. Turkish philanthropist and human rights activist Osman Kavala, who was charged with espionage and attempting to overthrow the constitutional order, remains in prison.

Most recently, espionage charges have been brought against the former Istanbul mayor and Erdogan's political competitor, Ekrem Imamoglu, and a number of journalists.

Hakki Tas, a research fellow and expert on Turkey at the German Institute for Global and Area Studies, said the number of such cases have been increasing over the past few years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on the one hand, turkey has the right to protect itself from foreign intelligence services — especially given geopolitical competition and conflict in the region, he argued. On the other hand, there's a long tradition of bringing the Turkish opposition to court to face security charges.

"What foreigners or employees of foreign institutions have experienced in recent years is a continuation of this pattern," Tas told DW.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

Diungkapkan bahwa media outlets and ngos critical of the government have faced investigations, trials and other sorts of state sanctions for years. The ruling AKP party has also brought in its own version of a so-called "foreign agent law. ".

These sorts of espionage cases serve both a domestic and foreign policy function, Tas said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for locals, "contact with a foreign institution, foreign funding or even a perfectly normal salary could become part of an investigation someday," he explained. "For opposition figures and civil society organizations, in particular, this can become a security issue. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in terms of foreign policy, the cases also show other countries that there are limits to their activities inside turkey. These kinds of accusations seem to become more frequent when there's some sort of foreign policy tension — for example, after Western criticism of how opposition groups were dealt with after the alleged coup in 2016, the aforementioned disputes about arms deliveries in connection with Syria, or criticism from abroad about the removal of elected mayors in Turkey.

It can also serve as a kind of "hostage diplomacy," Tas said.

Diungkapkan bahwa the case of us pastor brunson is a good example. After his arrest, the Turkish government proposed a trade with the Americans. They wanted to exchange Turkish preacher Fethullah Gulen, who lived in the US and who the Turkish government blamed for the 2016 coup attempt.

Berdasarkan laporan, this suspicion of foreign institutions isn't something that the erdogan government invented, tas points out. In the early 2000s, several representatives of German organizations were already made to stand trial in Turkey. At the time, it was alleged that, among other things, the German spy service was using German foundations as a front for conspiracy.

Diungkapkan bahwa in some of the best-known cases, defendants often don't end up convicted of espionage. In the case of activist Osman Kavala, he was initially acquitted of espionage several times and spent two years in prison, just because of those charges.

Diungkapkan bahwa but tas said that's no surprise, referring to a 1979 work about the sociology of law written by us law professor malcolm feeley. It's title: "The Process Is the Punishment. ".

This article was originally written in German.

Asian love ballads test Eurovision’s winning song formula.

Watch: People cheer as Pope Leo returns to remote Andes town in former diocese.

On a visit to an isolated Andean village in his former diocese, Pope Leo XIV has spoken about the "suffering of those who are forced to leave their homeland in search of a better future", which he said had left communities under threat.

About 6,000 people live in Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, which is located in a remote part of the Andes mountains in northern Peru, but the Pope's visit drew a crowd of about 20,000, according to the Vatican.

At an outdoor Mass, Pope Leo spoke of "declining birth rates that are emptying villages," and the unequal distribution of the land's resources.

Over 40% of the population in the Cajamarca region, where the town is located, live in poverty - the highest figure in Peru, according to official data.

Cajamarca has lost the highest number of people to internal migration, with 729,000 people born there now living elsewhere in Peru.

In his sermon, Pope Leo thanked those who had made the journey to him and emphasised the importance of never losing heart, despite life's difficulties.

Sebagaimana diketahui, santa cruz is within the diocese of chiclayo, where pope leo served as bishop from 2015 to 2023. During his tenure, he visited Santa Cruz several times a year to minister to the town's rural population.

Diungkapkan bahwa on saturday he returned by helicopter, where he was greeted by singing and cheering. He later did a tour in a popemobile, where he waved to people who had travelled from across the region to see him.

Speaking at a local parish on Saturday, the Pope said he felt "joy" at being able to visit the small town once again.

"It is like a very big dream that the Lord has allowed this servant to come here," he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rev. Kevin Noriega, who was ordained in 2018 by the then-bishop, told Reuters the visit had brought "enormous hope and emotion" to Santa Cruz.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he said: "people are eager to experience this holy mass. because after so much time they will be able to see their bishop - 'Father Robert,' as they used to call him - now as the Holy Father. ".

Watch: Why Pope Leoâs visit 'home' to Peru is so significant.

Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the leader of the Catholic church, who was elected in May 2025.

The 12-day trip has included stops in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in Peru carries personal significance.

The US-born pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the pontiff is set to leave chiclayo on sunday, when he will head to cusco, and then on to a peruvian sector of the amazon rainforest. His tour of the region will conclude on Monday, at which point Pope Leo will return to Rome.

Pope Leo XIV arrived at the remote Andean village in Peru by helicopter.

The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own.

#625. Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation

Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6j9mn7l14y0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

A federal judge has temporarily blocked the US government's closure of a historic golf course and park in Washington DC.

US District Judge Ana Reyes has been overseeing a months-long challenge to the president's plans for East Potomac Golf Links, which he said would be closed from 15 November for extensive renovations.

Reyes has said Donald Trump cannot close the park or its golf course, but added that his administration was not required to actively manage either.

Diungkapkan bahwa trump, an avid golfer, has said his plans to upgrade the 106-year-old course will create "one of the best and most spectacular golf courses anywhere in the world". The BBC has contacted the White House for comment.

Declaring the current course "Trash Island", he announced in October it would be renovated over 15 months to create a space that "will be open to the Public while, at the same time, designed to the Highest Level of Golf and able to hold World Class Tournaments" - despite the ongoing litigation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a 30-page decision issued on saturday, reyes said the trump administration's justifications for the proposed course closures were pretextual, and that the government violated at least two federal laws "to meet an arbitrary deadline. ".

"The Government proposes to close a historic park, daily enjoyed by Washingtonians of all stripes, indefinitely," Reyes wrote.

She said the closure "runs counter to the public interest in utilising national parkland", adding that the government had not "plausibly identified any harm it would suffer from a temporary restraining order that preserves the status quo pending further proceedings".

Her order will last until the 28 November.

'Trash Island' or DC landmark? How a golf course got Trump in a messy legal dispute.

The legal dispute dates back to February, when the DC Preservation League and others sued over redevelopment plans for the park.

The historic course, which sits 2 miles (3km) south of the White House, is one of three public courses run by the National Park Service in the nation's capital.

The legal fight then escalated in October, when the NPS began to cut down hundreds of trees without notifying Reyes until 15 hours before work was set to begin.

After the trees were cut, Reyes ordered the Trump administration to stop tree removal until at least 26 October and give her three business days' notice about making any other permanent changes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, despite the work stoppage, trump announced that the course would be closed for 15 months from 15 november to accommodate the renovations. He also shared a rendering of the course redesign.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the current course is old, broken, dilapidated, and of no further use or effect. It is in very poor condition, with falling, dangerous, and disease-infested trees and, importantly, a collapsing and hazardous seawall," he said in a post to Truth Social.

Reyes has since separately opened an inquiry into whether the justice department attorneys "have made misrepresentations to the court and otherwise violated ethical rules".

That included whether giving late notice to the court about the renovation plans was "done in bad faith" and whether the attorneys failed to correct previously false statements or withheld information.

She said she would carry out the inquiry with a special master, an independent third party.

Judge investigating whether Trump administration lied about golf course renovations.

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.

The failed federal Liberal candidate Katherine Deves, who campaigned to exclude transgender women from women’s sport, will stand for One Nation at next year’s New South Wales election.

Deves was among four NSW Legislative Council candidates announced by One Nation’s NSW leader, Mike Newman, on Sunday.

The other candidates were Arnon Wither, a construction worker from the Hunter region who works as an electorate officer for Senator Sean Bell; Manti Steele, a farmer, teacher and mother of eight from Dubbo; and Daniel Hill, a surf lifesaver from the state’s south coast.

The NSW election will be held on 13 March.

Newman said on Sunday the upper house candidates were “authentic”, “people from the real world” and not “career politicians”.

One Nation has only announced a single lower house candidate – Newman, in the electorate of Cessnock – but he said the party would run candidates in all 93 lower house seats.

“We want to make sure that these people bleed orange, and like I said, they’re all from the real world,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “that’s the that’s the type of person we’re aiming at … people from the real world who understand business, who understand their pinch points and pain points, understand the cost of living, understand cashflow. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, deves was handpicked by the former prime minister scott morrison to run in the federal nsw seat of warringah in 2022. Her candidacy was marred by controversy, including when she likened anti-trans activism to standing up against the Holocaust.

On Sunday she said she joined One Nation “because I wanted to be a part of the rescue, recovery, and restoration of our nation”.

“We are seeing cost of living skyrocket, whether it’s fuel, housing, energy, and we are watching a government that is so wedded to destructive ideologies like DEI and net zero that they are prepared to impoverish us all,” she said.

If elected, she would look to make changes to state laws regarding “discrimination, hate speech, vilification, birth certificates, etc”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “where we can restore clear and accurate language around biological sex, men and women, and ensure that women and girls are safe and have spaces for services, sports, etc, where it’s inappropriate for males to be there. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when guardian australia contacted deves about her potential candidacy in october, she directed inquiries to vikki campion, the nsw party’s part-time media adviser. Volatile weather predicted after storms on Saturday, with a man in his 20s struck by lightning while swimming on NSW Central Coast.

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.

Dangerous and severe “supercell” thunderstorms with the potential for giant hail and destructive winds were forecast for parts of New South Wales on Sunday, as volatile weather continued in the eastern states over the weekend.

Storms dumped heavy rain across large parts of northern and eastern NSW and much of Queensland on Saturday, with strong winds recorded up to 98km/h in Goulburn and rainfall totals of between 30mm and 50mm in the Coffs Harbour area.

Berdasarkan laporan, a man in his 20s was struck by lightning while swimming at ettalong beach on nsw’s central coast on saturday afternoon. He was pulled from the water by fellow swimmers and given CPR by first responders until NSW Ambulance paramedics arrived. He was taken to Gosford hospital in a serious condition, and later transferred to Royal North Shore hospital.

The young man was in a critical but stable condition on Sunday morning, a hospital spokesperson said.

Witnesses said while there was storm activity visible in the distance towards Gosford, the area around the beach was clear and sunny and that the lightning bolt appeared to come “out of nowhere”.

Lightning can strike up to 30km from the centre of a storm cell.

Sunday was expected to be “another big storm day”, with “very dangerous and severe thunderstorms” likely for north-eastern NSW, said Sarah Scully, senior meteorologist at the Bureau of Meteorology.

Those storms could bring hail with a diameter greater than 5cm, and winds in excess of 120km/h.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “that’s being driven by a southerly change that’s pushing up the new south wales coast,” scully said. “It’s a potential trigger for these supercell high-end thunderstorms. ”.

Severe thunderstorms with 2cm hail, wind gusts in excess of 90km/h, heavy rainfall and flash flooding was possible on Sunday through a broader area of NSW extending down towards inland parts of the ranges to the east of Sydney, and pushing up into south-east and central parts of Queensland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, storms were expected in sydney on sunday, but were likely to be less severe than further north, though rain was likely. The forecast temperature was 23C. Showers and thunderstorms were expected in Brisbane with a top of 31C.

The BoM expected to release more severe weather warnings throughout Sunday as the storms develop.

On Monday, the risk of high-end severe thunderstorms would move into the NSW northern rivers and south-eastern parts of Queensland, including Brisbane, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast, again with the potential to bring giant hail, destructive winds, and intense rain that could lead to life-threatening flash flooding.

“That again is being driven by that trough that’s pushing up the coast combined with the very humid conditions that eastern Australia has been experiencing the last few days,” Scully said.

A coastal trough with a low-pressure system appeared to be developing off the north coast of NSW near the Queensland border, which had the potential to bring even more rain onto the coast.

“How much rainfall accumulates is highly dependent on how close that trough sits to the coast, and also how long it lingers there,” Scully said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “at this state we’re only expecting moderate rainfall totals during tomorrow from that coastal trough, between 30mm to 70mm, easing into tuesday morning. If they just move that little bit closer to the coast they can sometimes dump a whole lot of rain. But we are watching it very closely as rainfall totals associated with these coastal troughs are notoriously challenging to predict. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, elsewhere, there were showers developing in melbourne on sunday with a forecast top of 17c. There was a high chance of showers in Hobart, with 13C expected, and cloudy in Adelaide with a mild 20C forecast. It was partly cloudy in Canberra, where they were expecting 24C, and in Perth, with an expected top of 28C. Darwin was expecting 34C and an afternoon storm.

#631. Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy

📅 15 Nov 2026

Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6dj1e8wyykmo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

Five-times Olympic champion Teddy Riner is one of France's most popular athletes.

Apart from an overwhelming urge to pin one's opponent to the floor of the house, there is no obvious connection between politics and the world of top-level judo.

That has not stopped France's much-garlanded world heavyweight champion Teddy Riner from throwing his hat into the ring for next April's presidential race.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the guadeloupe-born 37-year-old may have no experience of public office, no party behind him, and as yet no manifesto. All so far is a slogan La France qu'on aime (The France we love), a declaration on social media, and a campaign visit to a hospital in the Seine-Saint-Denis suburb of northern Paris.

But it would be a foolhardy pundit who would totally write off his chances.

Diungkapkan bahwa riner is, after all, one of the most popular figures in modern-day france, regularly topping the polls for embodying the nation's "values". He is a proven winner, with five Olympic golds and 11 world championships under his belt, as well as a successful career in business.

Berdasarkan laporan, more than 28 million people have watched his election broadcast on instagram and x, shot with proper presidential decorum against a backdrop of books and a french flag. Some 22% told an Ifop poll within 24 hours they "could" vote for him.

Diungkapkan bahwa teddy riner's video has attracted 14. 5 million views on Instagram alone.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, actors and television personalities have become presidents in other countries. The ex-leader of Liberia â George Weah â was formerly a professional footballer.

So why not a judoka in the ÃlysÃ©e Palace?.

"Anyone who thinks that being out of the political in-crowd disqualifies Riner from running for the ÃlysÃ©e would be very wrong," says Guillaume Tabard of Le Figaro.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "but [riner] too would be wrong if he thinks not belonging to the in-crowd is all it takes. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa for now the whole of the french political world has decided to take the riner candidacy seriously â or at least to pretend to. That is partly because he is such a popular personality that mocking his political hopes could easily rebound badly.

But it is also because the state of French politics â outside of the burgeoning forces of the hard left and hard right â is one of total disarray.

The centre-ground is floundering, with no candidate yet emerging who can inspire anything like the sense of mission of hard-right leader Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc MÃ©lenchon on the hard left, who for now look set to face off in the final round of the presidential election in May.

So when a popular figure like Riner enters the race - proclaiming himself "neither left, nor right", wanting to "unite the country" and "put money back in people's pockets", railing equally against "racists" and "yobs who scare people off our streets" â politicians have to take note.

Hard-right leader Marine Le Pen currently leads the polls in the race to be France's next president.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it is perfectly possible, probable even, that riner's campaign will fizzle out after a brief period of hype, and that the judoka will after all be a joker in the pack. But it is also possible that it won't, in which case the pre-election arithmetic will need a hasty readjustment: and it won't be the centrists who are smiling.

Thus far, Riner has shown himself a master of the codes required for this kind of out-of-nowhere candidacy, the first of which is to press home the message: "Don't Worry! I'm NOT a Politician!".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this day and age in france, anyone who smacks of the "system" is automatically downgraded in voters' eyes, so it is important to emphasise that you are only running for office because, one, you have experienced real life (unlike those loafers in paris); and two, you have discovered that there are solutions out there for the country's many problems. Solutions that are invisible to those same blinkered apparatchiks.

All this Riner was able to express in last Monday's social media broadcast by using sophisticated rhetorical devices.

"People say I am a fool for wanting to run for the presidency," he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "am i a fool? well, if refusing to see france sink under the weight of debt; refusing to see mothers and fathers grit their teeth every time they do their weekly shop, and tremble with fear when their kids go out on the streetâ¦ if all that means being a fool, then yes call me a fool. ".

It was a promising oratorial start for the sportsman, and certainly attracted the viewers.

Are student protests being manipulated ahead of France's presidential election?.

France's Marine Le Pen, fighting court conviction and running for presidency.

But if he is serious â and Riner says he never does anything half-heartedly - that's not how he became an Olympic champion â then the hard work begins now.

What does Riner actually want to do? Who will be on his team? Where does he position himself on the all-consuming matters of the day: pension-reform, investment in education, the cost of living, public debt, the rise of populism or Russia's war in Ukraine?.

In short, how does he intend to transform his undeniable popularity as a sporting figure into a political mandate?.

Protesters have for weeks taken to the streets in France over wages, the cost of living and public services.

Sebagaimana diketahui, broadly, riner appears to be on the right on economic matters and law and order, but being black and of caribbean background he is also very strong on racism. When he says he is anti-extremism, he is referring mainly to Marine Le Pen.

In other words his pitch is somewhere in the centre, and against the extremes.

The trouble is, this is already an extremely crowded area, with important figures like ex-prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal signally failing to take off.

Currently there are a dozen or so candidates in the area between centre right and centre left, stretching from the Socialist-backed RaphaÃ«l Glucksman to the Republicans' Bruno Retailleau on the right.

The latest possible addition is Christine Lagarde, who steps down as head of the European Central Bank next February.

President Emmanuel Macron is among the few politicians who appears genuinely pleased by Riner's decision to run.

The addition of yet another contender will dilute their polling numbers even further, making a second-round qualification for MÃ©lenchon more likely.

Diungkapkan bahwa so no wonder the leader of france unbowed (lfi) seemed so happy about riner's decision to run. "We know how it goes: neither right nor left means not left," MÃ©lenchon told reporters on Friday.

The only other politician who seems genuinely pleased, rather than putting on a fixed smile, is President Emmanuel Macron, who said Riner was a "great champion" and that politics "did not belong to the professionals".

That could be explained by the president's cool relations with his former prime ministers, Philippe and Attal, both of whom are doing all they can to distance themselves from their unpopular one-time boss.

Riner said he viewed Macron's praise as a "poisoned chalice", telling reporters on Saturday that he was "not the president's envoy, I'm not a Macronist".

Politics and judo have very little in common, but of the two, as Riner will soon discover, the more vicious is not the one that is fought out hand-to-hand after mutual acknowledgement on the tatami mat.

In Japanese, judo actually means "the gentle way".

If he starts looking like a serious candidate, Riner must know his life will be turned upside down, not just his physical form.

Diungkapkan bahwa in politics you do not bow in respect to your opponent. You give him a metaphorical headbutt.

#632. David Jones’ future looks grim. Is Myer next?

📅 14 Nov 2026

David Jones’ future looks grim. Is Myer next?

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/15/myer-david-jones-stores-closures-administration

With Myer’s profitability battered and share price languishing near all-time lows, DJs’ slide into administration raises an uncomfortable question.

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.

When the retailer’s doors slide open, shoppers are greeted by rows of slashed price tags, frantic discounting, and all the other hallmarks of a department store closing down.

Except this isn’t David Jones, the embattled upmarket retailer that is shutting half its 38 stores.

This is its longtime rival, Myer, where entire floors are seemingly permanently on sale.

With Myer’s profitability battered and share price languishing near all-time lows, DJs’ slide into administration raises an uncomfortable question: is Myer next?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at first glance, myer’s headline numbers seem to defy the retail gloom, with double-digit sales growth to $4. 1bn last financial year.

That lift, however, was not driven by surging demand, but by adding sales from the newly acquired apparel chains, Just Jeans, Jay Jays, Portmans, Dotti and Jacqui E, bought from billionaire businessman Solomon Lew’s Premier Investments.

Meanwhile, to keep registers ringing, Myer employed “higher than planned promotional activity to stimulate demand”, according to its annual report, which reduced its profitability.

The department store has also slashed the value of its brands, down more than $200m in one year alone, in an admission that its labels are worth far less than they once were.

Department stores have faced a “sustained erosion of relevance over the past five years”, according to IBISWorld market researchers, as online platforms win over bargain-hunters and specialists like beauty retailer Mecca prove more nimble in capturing shifting tastes.

DJs and Myer, on the other hand, have been weighed down by long-running physical property leases tied to underperforming stores in their sprawling networks.

The era of Australian families being fiercely loyal to either David Jones or Myer is long gone, replaced by a grim battle for both chains to stay relevant.

The stress on big department store profitability has been exacerbated by a period of cost of living pressures that have “entrenched deal-hunting behaviour, reshaping how and when consumers engage with department stores”, according to IBISWorld.

Myer, however, has a critical advantage over David Jones: time.

While DJs fell into administration under mounting debts, Myer finished last financial year with a $100m net cash buffer, buying management breathing space to fix the business.

It has been reducing store numbers and with it lease liabilities – down to 56 stores from 60 before the pandemic – which is something David Jones is only doing now that it has collapsed into administration.

For the moment, Myer is leaning into the discounts demanded by shoppers, in the hope that more profitable trading conditions will emerge.

Richard Hemming, the editor at Under The Radar Report, says in retail “volume is everything”.

“If you get the volumes through, that customer base will eventually be in a position to pay more, and when volumes and margins both improve, you get that double effect,” Hemming says.

While analysts have mixed views on whether permanent discounting is a smart survival tactic or a slow-motion way to go bankrupt, department stores do need to move huge volumes of stock to keep cash flowing and clear seasonal goods.

They can use those discounts to get more people signed up to their loyalty programs – such as the successful Myer One scheme – in the hope they will become long-term customers.

Hemming sees the upside in Myer’s current pain, noting the retailer is “cleaning house earlier than rivals” precisely because investors have long priced it “like it’s going to go broke”.

Myer is revamping the business to aggressively pursue online sales.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, myer shares have been heavily sold down over the years, and now hover around the 24c mark, representing a fraction of its $4. 10 float price from 2009.

It did, however, receive a price bump on the day DJs fell into administration.

With roughly two in five Myer stores sharing a shopping centre with a David Jones outlet, investors are betting the coming closure of 19 DJs sites will hand Myer an easy market-share boost, even as its own long-term turnaround demands further store cuts.

In the short term, the pain is likely to intensify for Myer as the David Jones stores marked for closure are under orders to clear stock with widespread promotions, luring customers.

Broader retail sentiment is also souring, as a string of interest rate rises and escalating cost-of-living pressures force cash-strapped shoppers to pare their discretionary spend.

The Retail Doctor Group’s chief executive, Brian Walker, says the main long-term advantage Myer has over its old rival is financial flexibility.

“Whereas David Jones was incredibly encumbered, Myer doesn’t have that issue right now,” Walker says.

Berdasarkan laporan, “as we sit here today, myer is financially stronger, but strategically still pretty vulnerable. ”.

#633. My mother told me I would die if I sought treatment for Ebola - I am proof you can survive

📅 15 Nov 2026

My mother told me I would die if I sought treatment for Ebola - I am proof you can survive

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvg2e2q28w1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

When Dr Raymond Kasereka Kamwanga told his family he suspected he had Ebola and was going to a treatment centre in the city of Butembo in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, his family were horrified.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, they regarded the specialised unit as a "death house" as not many patients do recover - especially those admitted in the late stages of the illness. His 50-year-old mother was in tears, pleading with him not to go there.

"Why are you choosing to die at the Ebola treatment centre?" Masika Ndungo had asked him.

But as a doctor at Butembo's Katwa Hospital, he knew that if stayed at home, he was unlikely to survive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this was in july, two months after the world health organization (who) had declared the ebola outbreak in dr congo a public health emergency of international concern. Since then 5,400 people have died and 11,000 have been infected, making it the second-most deadly outbreak ever recorded.

Butembo is in North Kivu province, the epicentre of the crisis, with the highest number of reported cases, according to the Congolese health ministry.

Dr Kamwanga is one of 3,031 people who have survived - and is evangelical about sharing his story in an effort to help stop the spread of infections devastating his community.

After staring death in the face and overcoming ostracisation, he has even started writing a book about his experience.

"As someone who has recovered, I am living proof that the disease exists, but also that it is possible to recover from it," he tells the BBC outside Katwa Hospital where he still works.

The 30-year-old medic believes he contracted the virus through contact with a patient in a setting where protective measures are not always adequate.

Raymond Kasereka Kamwanga uses his book to help convince sceptics that Ebola is real.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first symptoms appeared gradually: a bitter taste in his mouth, headaches and a general feeling of malaise. He contacted the Ebola response team.

After an initial consultation and some tests, he returned home, but his condition did not improve.

Butembo does not have the equipment to quickly test for Ebola - samples need to be sent to the city of Beni, 54km (33 miles) north.

This delays diagnosis as the condition of roads in this war-torn and underdeveloped part of DR Congo means it can take between 48 and 72 hours to travel even this relatively short distance.

Berdasarkan laporan, after three days at home, kamwanga felt extremely weak and experienced muscle pain. On the fourth day, he began vomiting and had diarrhoea.

This is when he gathered his family members - including his mother - to tell them he had to go to the Ebola treatment centre.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "she had started crying, along with my sisters. I told them everything would be alright, that I was a doctor and that I was confident. But they weren't reassured," he says.

Around 18:00, he set off on foot to the nearby centre but refused to use the main entrance.

Diungkapkan bahwa he called his colleagues and asked them to put on their protective gear before they approached him and isolated him. The virus spreads from one person to another by contact with infected bodily fluids.

Dr Kamwanga's mother says his experience has helped dispel some of the misinformation she had heard about Ebola.

The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment.

"The treatment given to Ebola patients is symptomatic - meaning that doctors treat the symptoms the patient presents," says Kamwanga, explaining that in his case it was severe vomiting and diarrhoea.

In some patients these symptoms can lead to organ failure and then some develop internal and external bleeding.

Kamwanga lost a lot of fluid and struggled to stay hydrated - he was terrified.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i was afraid for myself. Every day, patients were dying right before my eyes. But I stayed positive," he explains.

Over 13 days lying in his hospital bed, he tried to keep his spirits up by watching movies and TV shows on his phone, reading and scrolling through TikTok.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the day he learned he had recovered, kamwanga felt immense relief. He thanked the healthcare workers who had cared for him.

However, even a certificate showing he was Ebola-free did not initially dispel the unease those around him felt after he was discharged.

What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult?.

'I buried my parents one day after the other' - Ebola mourners learn how to grieve safely.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we welcomed him home warmly. But because of our fear, we didn't get close to him any more," Ndungo, his mother, tells the BBC.

For 21 days - the incubation period of the virus - the doctor lived separately in another part of the family home, which was crowded at the time with at least 18 people living there, including several children and people displaced by recent fighting in the region.

He would only see them from afar when he went to pick up his meal, while other family members kept their distance.

Neighbour Kavugho Sifa shared these concerns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we were really afraid, but we prayed to god to protect him at the treatment centre. With God's help and the doctors' efforts, we saw him return in good health," she tells the BBC.

They all agree the experience changed their perception of Ebola.

Some do not believe the disease even exists - Ndungo says that witnessing Ebola first-hand helped to dispel some of that misinformation.

After his recovery, Kamwanga threw himself into community outreach - sharing his story as a way of combatting rumours and mistrust.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i started writing my book - the price of saving lives - one week after recovering and leaving the hospital," he says. "However, it is not finished yet. What I currently use during my awareness-raising activities is the draft, and it is already making a significant impact. ".

During these sessions, he also distributes photos taken while he was sick to help convince residents that Ebola is real.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but in butembo, this mission remains difficult. Kamwanga explains that some people view awareness campaigns as a way for humanitarian organisations to profit from donor funding.

Such mistrust, which is also levelled at healthcare professionals, is often fuelled by poverty and trauma related to years of armed conflict, he says.

"Ebola has come alongside the war," he says, explaining that some even interpret it as a way for those in authority to threaten a vulnerable population "to finish off those whom the war failed to exterminate".

He also believes that the number of deaths observed during epidemics - compared to recoveries, which are sometimes less visible - reinforce fear and suspicion.

But putting himself on the front line also comes with risks - and Kamwanga says he receives death threats on his phone.

Diungkapkan bahwa some residents accuse him of being paid to spread information about ebola. He also reports that outreach workers have been attacked by members of the community.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he feels the authorities do not work effectively to address all these problems: "our government is taking things lightly. ".

He agrees too with the recent report by MÃ©decins Sans FrontiÃ¨res (MSF) that Ebola funds are going missing.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the money allocated to the ebola response is being misappropriated by the government. We do not have enough protective equipment," the medic says.

The BBC has asked the Congolese government for comment.

Despite the intimidation and the obstacles he and other medics face, he remains determined - his goal is to help put an end to the disease.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "should we give up the fight against ebola? no. We continue to do what we can with the resources available to us, which are unfortunately very limited. ".

#634. UK government to consider changing age of consent after allegations against Russell Brand

📅 15 Nov 2026

UK government to consider changing age of consent after allegations against Russell Brand

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/15/uk-government-to-consider-changing-age-of-consent-after-allegations-against-russell-brand

Deputy prime minister says change would be a massive step but ‘deserves proper consideration and scrutiny’.

The government has said it will consider calls to change the age of consent after a woman waived her right to anonymity to publicly claim she was raped by Russell Brand as a 16-year-old schoolgirl.

Mia Latter, now 37, alleged she had been orally raped by the jailed comedian when she was a teenager and he was 30 years old.

In an interview with the Sunday Times, she called for the introduction of a staggered age of consent – which would make relationships between adults and teenagers aged 16 and 17 illegal.

Louise Haigh, the de facto deputy prime minister, told the newspaper that Latter’s “heart-breaking story” meant a law change deserved consideration.

She said: “We need to listen to Mia and other victims like her who have been through these experiences because it’s really important that as lawmakers their experience is at the heart of what we consider.

Berdasarkan laporan, “it clearly would be a massive step to change the age of consent, but it deserves proper consideration and scrutiny. I can absolutely understand why she is calling for it. ”.

Under UK law, adults of any age are legally able to have sex with 16 and 17-year-olds.

Latter said: “It’s shocking to me time and time again that whenever the news comes up again about him, it’s always in the comments about the relationship with a 16-year-old.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “that’s not the most heinous bit. But why is that the thing that everybody collectively gets stuck on? I think we all sort of agree that … adults shouldn’t be allowed to have sexual relationships with children, with somebody under the age of 18. That really doesn’t seem like a gigantic leap to take. ”.

Latter was referred to under the pseudonym of Alice in previous reporting by the Sunday Times, the Times, and Channel 4’s Dispatches documentary.

She was 16 when she first met Brand in Leicester Square, central London, while she was on her way home from a shopping trip.

He took her number and later messaged her, asking if she wanted to go for dinner, she said.

She told the newspaper that Brand – who was working at MTV at the time – still asked her to meet after she had confessed her age to him.

Latter alleges Brand orally raped her towards the end of their three-month relationship.

Brand denied all of the allegations made against him by Latter when they were first reported in 2023 by the Times.

She spoke to the police after the documentary, but the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) decided not to include her case in Brand’s trial at Southwark Crown Court.

He was convicted of attacks against four of the six women who gave evidence against him, and is now serving a 10-and-a-half-year prison term for one count of rape and three sexual assaults.

Earlier this week, it was announced that a series of “serious” sex offence allegations against comedian David Walliams are being probed by the Metropolitan police after an investigation by the Guardian and ITV News.

One woman described her alleged encounter with Walliams when she was 15 as “sexual assault”.

Berdasarkan laporan, haigh went on to say that, in light of news that one of walliams’s accusers was asked to sign a non disclosure agreement (nda), the government should also look at banning them in cases of alleged sexual assault and harassment. She said: “When we consider the allegations against David Walliams, teenagers who were fans wouldn’t come under the current consultation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i do think there is a very strong case to look at banning ndas in all circumstances where they relate to harassment or discrimination, to make sure that no victim, regardless of where it happened or what their relationship was with the perpetrator, should ever be silenced. ”.

It is believed MPs outside Labour may support a bill to change the age of consent laws, with Jess Brown-Fuller, the Liberal Democrat justice spokesperson, coming out in favour of reviewing them.

Commending Latter for the “extraordinary bravery” it took to waive her anonymity, Brown-Fuller said: “I think we must go further to increase protections for young women and girls, and looking at a staggered age of consent is an important step.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we already have rules that recognise power imbalances in professions: between teachers and students, or barristers and junior colleagues. It’s time for the government to recognise the implicit power imbalance held by older men over teenage girls. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, latter’s decision to come forward was also praised by bridget phillipson, the minister for women and equalities, who said she “and thousands of others across the country will be in awe of her courage and determination”. She added that it is “up to all of us to send a message to women and girls who experience sexual violence: the shame is not yours. Women like Mia are leading the charge, but we can and must do more to make this a moment of change. ”.

Latter’s allegation was reported to the Met police, who said the investigation into the alleged rape remains ongoing.

A Met Police spokesperson said: “Officers launched an investigation in January 2026 after receiving an allegation of rape.

“Detectives sought advice from the Crown Prosecution Service to determine how best to proceed, and officers were advised that further information was needed before a charging decision could be made.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “this investigation remains ongoing. However, our focus has been on putting forward the best possible evidence. We understand the delay has been distressing for this victim-survivor. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the cps said: “the crown prosecution service will continue to work closely with investigators to provide advice and make sure cases progress as quickly as possible. ”.

#635. SpaceX’s Starship returns to launch pad from orbit in victory for company

📅 14 Nov 2026

SpaceX’s Starship returns to launch pad from orbit in victory for company

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/nov/14/spacex-starship-double-catch

Although booster exploded, company caught upper stage for first time in campaign to make megarocket reusable.

SpaceX’s megarocket Starship returned to its Texas launch tower on Saturday, a milestone in the company’s efforts to make the craft suitable for human spaceflight.

The 171ft (52-meter) bullet-shaped upper stage descended into the clutch of the tower’s mechanical arms, ending a 22hr mission where the craft orbited Earth 14 times.

Starship’s 15th test flight was envisioned as a historic double-catch mission, where all parts of the rocket would be returned intact to the launch site, rather than recovered from the ocean as with some previous test flights.

The hulking spacecraft is composed of two parts: a lower booster stage called Super Heavy, whose Raptor engines powered the orbital ascent, and an upper stage also called Starship.

Those double-catch ambitions were dashed on Friday, when the booster diverted a few minutes after takeoff and exploded in the Gulf of Mexico.

The guidance, navigation and control (GNC) system triggered the no-go.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “it was doing what it was supposed to do. Basically, it detected that the booster was not in the place it was supposed to be to proceed with a catch,” SpaceX spokesperson Dan Huot said early on Saturday. The booster was also “slightly low on fuel”, according to SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk.

This week’s test flight was still a victory for SpaceX, marking the first time that the company caught its upper stage.

It was also only the second time Starship has entered Earth’s orbit.

Berdasarkan laporan, the feat comes as the 2028 date nears for nasa’s plan to return humans to the lunar surface. The agency has contracted SpaceX and Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin for the mission.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “making more believers by the day,” wrote nasa administrator jared isaacman on x, praising the 15th flight. “One step closer to [the moon]. ” Isaacman is an ally of Musk, who advised Donald Trump to appoint him to lead Nasa.

Diungkapkan bahwa spacex has plans to ramp up its starship test flights to a weekly, then twice-weekly cadence, musk said on a recent earnings call. He has sought to make Starship rapidly reusable so that it can land and take off much like standard airplanes. Musk has touted the rocket’s reusability as a way to reel in the enormous costs of space travel.

Beyond another Moon landing, Musk has also pushed a plan of carrying humans to Mars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, starship’s advances have also aided the expansion of musk’s satellite internet empire. The spacecraft deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites during this recent flight.

Some 106,000 people marched through French cities for a fifth consecutive weekend of protests, marking the lowest turnout in recent weeks.

Tens of thousands of protesters took to the streets across France on Saturday to demonstrate against the rising cost of living and strained public services, the Interior Ministry said.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

Mass protests have swept across the European Union's second-largest economy for more than a month.

What began in September as student protests against teacher shortages and poor facilities has since evolved into a broader movement fuelled by anger over the rising cost of living, strained public services and police brutality.

In mid-October, around 565,000 people took to the streets across France, as riots, looting and clashes disrupted demonstrations in several cities.

As France entered its fifth consecutive weekend of nationwide unrest, President Emmanuel Macron's approval ratings fell to the lowest level since he took office in 2017, according to recent polls.

The French government doesn't have much room to respond to the protesters' demands due to its high debt.

The Phillippines on Saturday became the first winner of the Asian version of the Eurovision Song Contest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, eleven countries, including south korea, malaysia and vietnam, took part in the song contest in the thai capital, bangkok. However, major nations in the region such as China, Japan and India were absent from the event.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 19-year-old carmelle collado's dance song "sobra-sobra" (too much) won the competition. The song, which features lyrics in both English and Tagalog, is an empowering tribute to Filipino women.

It will mark the latest challenge to the prime minister, Andrej Babiš, and his coalition of populist, hard-right nationalist and Eurosceptic parties, and follows weeks of demonstrations in towns and cities and a strike by staff at Czech TV and Czech Radio.

The proposed changes, which would cut state television and radio budgets by about 15%, have drawn fire from international media organisations.

The European Broadcasting Union, the European Federation of Journalists, Reporters Without Borders and the International Press Institute have also criticised the government’s media plan, likening it to controversial moves by Slovakia’s prime minister, Robert Fico, and Hungary’s former premier Viktor Orbán.
